title: Nagata's conjecture for plane curves
summary: We prove that a nonzero effective plane curve of degree d at r ≥ 10 very general complex points has total multiplicity strictly less than $`d\sqrt r`$. The inequality holds simultaneously for all curves, including reducible and nonreduced curves, and establishes Nagata's conjecture in its strict, nonhomogeneous form.
family_title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants

review.reason: Proves a strict multiplicity bound for plane curves through very general points, as Nagata's conjecture.

discussion.title: On OpenAI's proof of the Nagata conjecture
